message.content:
A portrait-oriented magazine cover features the title "TEMPO" in large white serif letters against a background of tangled grey industrial pipes. Below the title, the yellow text "BP MIGAS TAMAT" is centered. At the top, white text reads "HEBOH GRASI OLA" and "LAPORAN DARI PERANG SURIAH." Small white text below the main title indicates "EDISI 19-25 NOVEMBER 2012."

In the lower right corner, a man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a dark robe with a white and orange bib, holds a red circular valve wheel attached to a vertical pipe. To his right, white text reads "Moh. Mahfud Md., Ketua Mahkamah Konstitusi." The pipe network is composed of numerous interlocking, curved, and straight grey tubes. The man's hand grips the red valve, which is part of a pipe assembly that includes two gauges. The bottom left includes pricing and a barcode: "RP 29.700," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273." The background behind the lower pipes and the man is plain white.
